name: Cultist
source:
A member of the cult that worships the sealed god and Tsuchigumo.

The cult is led by those calling themselves priests, and has members all across Japan. It's understood that it already existed a century ago, but it's present methods differ significantly from what was the case back then.

The cult's activity has seen a sharp increase these last few years.

[Translated from [url=https://k-yomiji.sakura.ne.jp/kyouhime/#a_chara9]the official description[/url].]
